correctness.limitations: These are finite tests. The frozen verifier's comparison beyond prefix 21 is by row sums, despite constructing a bivariate recurrence array; the fresh per-coefficient comparison remedies that limitation as a finite check only. The all-prefix result uses the bijection.
correctness.rationale: Greedy positions are componentwise earliest. The first position is 1+b, and each following letter uses one position plus one more exactly when it agrees with its predecessor. Reversal pairs all adjacency flags except for the centrally equal pair of an even palindrome. Thus the h free flags for length 2h+1 or h-1 for length 2h, together with b, determine the palindrome uniquely, giving the exact endpoint and stated binomial multiplicities. The two length parities give seeds (1+x)xy and (1+x)x^3 y^2 and the common factor x^2 y^2(1+x^2) per free flag. Cumulative inclusion contributes exactly 1/(1-x). The empty prefix, length one, and length two agree; at any fixed k the maximum endpoint is 2k with equality only for 1^k. A fresh distinct-subword-set enumeration agreed on every length and first-appearance step through prefix 17; a denominator recurrence agreed with all 11325 per-length coefficients through prefix 150.
